title: rosa canina f. firmula
intro: Rosa canina f. firmula, commonly known as the firm-leaved rose or dwarf wild rose, is a shrub-like plant with a compact growth habit, belonging to the Rosa genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. firmula include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for human consumption.
